purpose: Observe error identity, original matcher branch and public API boundary without changing acceptance, processor/catalog profile or engine binaries.
interpretationLimits: Compile/execute labels identify public API call boundaries, not automatically normative static/dynamic phases or conformance defects.
The specification permits early detection of some dynamic errors and optional modes that defer reporting of static errors in unevaluated code.
Multiple violated rules can permit different reported errors. A catalog mismatch is a review candidate, not a proven engine defect.
Structured QName identity is authoritative when available. Unstructured leading codes are distinguished from QName proof; uncoded or ambiguous reports remain unclassified.
Legacy decisions and all fixture/oracle alternatives are preserved. Independent exact comparisons do not become a new gate or a new production mode.
